classification.difficultyReason: Arrange two inward vertices separated by another vertex while retaining a closed, noncrossing five-sided boundary and two reflex interior angles.

content.prompt: Draw a pentagon with two non-adjacent reflex angles.

answer.short:
One possible drawing is shown.

The two inward shoulder vertices do not share a side, so their reflex angles are non-adjacent.
answer.worked: Draw a closed five-sided polygon with an inward vertex on each side of a central peak. Both inward vertices have reflex interior angles. The peak lies between them, so they are non-adjacent.

spec.description: Unfilled five-sided sample with a horizontal base, central peak and two separated inward shoulder vertices.
